metadata.title: Pooh Honey NFT Airdrop and Free Public Mint for Pooh DAO PFP Collection
metadata.description:
# Pooh Honey NFT Airdrop and Free Public Mint for Pooh DAO PFP Collection
**
Proposal Overview:**

This proposal aims to create a Pooh Honey NFT airdrop for current Pooh token holders and a free public mint for the wider community. The Pooh Honey NFTs will be redeemable for the official Pooh DAO Profile Picture (PFP) collection. All secondary sales of these NFTs will directly benefit the Pooh DAO treasury. We propose leveraging the Manifold platform (https://manifold.xyz/) for the free mint and redeem process.
**
Background:**

As the Pooh DAO community continues to grow, it is essential to engage and reward our supporters with unique and valuable initiatives. The creation of a Pooh Honey NFT airdrop and free public mint event will not only incentivize community participation but also contribute to the Pooh DAO treasury through secondary sales.

Proposal Details:

Pooh Honey NFT Airdrop:

a. Design and mint unique Pooh Honey NFTs on the Ethereum network.
b. Create a whitelisted mint link for current Pooh token holders, allowing them to claim 25 jars of Pooh Honey NFTs each.
c. Conduct a snapshot of Pooh token holders to determine eligibility for the airdrop.
d. Distribute the Pooh Honey NFTs to eligible holders via the whitelisted mint link.

Free Public Mint:

a. Design and mint additional Pooh Honey NFTs for the public mint event.
b. Implement a free public mint that allows users to claim 1 jar of Pooh Honey NFT per wallet.
c. Promote the public mint event through social media, community forums, and other platforms to attract new users.

**Redeem Pooh Honey NFTs for Pooh DAO PFP Collection:**

a. Develop the Pooh DAO official PFP collection and mint corresponding NFTs.
b. Implement a redemption mechanism on the Manifold platform, allowing users to redeem their Pooh Honey NFTs for the Pooh DAO PFP collection.
c. Inform the community about the redemption process and provide assistance as needed.

**Secondary Sales and Pooh DAO Treasury:**

a. Ensure that all secondary sales of Pooh Honey NFTs and Pooh DAO PFP collection NFTs directly contribute to the Pooh DAO treasury.
b. Regularly update the community on the amount contributed to the treasury through secondary sales.
c. Utilize funds generated through secondary sales for future community initiatives, developments, and growth.

**Budget and Timeline:**

The estimated budget for this proposal is 5,000 USD, which will be allocated as follows:

Design and minting of Pooh Honey NFTs and Pooh DAO PFP collection: 2,000 USD
Development and implementation of the redemption mechanism: 1,000 USD
Marketing and promotion of the airdrop and public mint event: 2,000 USD
The proposed timeline for completing the project is three months from the approval of this proposal, with the following milestones:

Week 1-2: Design and mint Pooh Honey NFTs, and develop the Pooh DAO PFP collection.
Week 3-4: Conduct the Pooh Honey NFT airdrop and launch the free public mint event.
Week 4-5: Implement the redemption mechanism on the Manifold platform and monitor secondary sales.
Conclusion:

The Pooh Honey NFT airdrop and free public mint event will strengthen community engagement, attract new users, and generate revenue for the Pooh DAO treasury through secondary sales. By leveraging the Manifold platform for the mint and redemption process, we ensure

metadata.title: Pooh Token Buyback and Staking Rewards Program Enhancement
metadata.description:
# Pooh Token Buyback and Staking Rewards Program Enhancement
**Proposal Overview:
**
This proposal aims to utilize 2 ETH to buy back Pooh tokens from the open market and add the acquired tokens to the existing staking rewards program. This initiative will help support the Pooh token's market value, increase staking rewards for our community members, and demonstrate the commitment of Pooh DAO to foster long-term value creation.

**Background**:

The Pooh DAO has successfully implemented a staking rewards program, which incentivizes users to stake their Pooh tokens and contribute to the stability and growth of the ecosystem. The community has expressed a strong interest in increasing the staking rewards to further encourage active participation and engagement.

**Proposal Details:
**
Buyback of Pooh Tokens:

a. Allocate 2 ETH from the DAO's treasury for the purpose of buying back Pooh tokens.
b. Execute the buyback through a decentralized exchange (DEX) over a predetermined period, with the goal of minimizing market impact and price fluctuations.
c. Maintain transparency in the buyback process by providing regular updates on the amount of Pooh tokens acquired and the average purchase price.

Addition of Acquired Pooh Tokens to the Staking Rewards Program:

a. Transfer the purchased Pooh tokens to the existing staking rewards smart contract.
b. Update the staking rewards distribution algorithm to account for the increased token supply.
c. Inform the community of the enhanced staking rewards program and encourage increased participation.

**Monitoring and Reporting:
**
a. Monitor the impact of the buyback and staking rewards enhancement on Pooh token price and staking participation.
b. Provide regular reports to the community on key metrics, such as the total amount of Pooh tokens staked, rewards distributed, and the overall health of the Pooh DAO ecosystem.

**Budget and Timeline:
**
The estimated budget for this proposal is 2 ETH, which will be sourced from the DAO's treasury.

The proposed timeline for executing the buyback and enhancing the staking rewards program is one month from the approval of this proposal, with the following milestones:

Week 1: Approval of the proposal and allocation of 2 ETH from the treasury.
Week 1: Execution of Pooh token buyback on a decentralized exchange.
Week 1-2: Addition of acquired Pooh tokens to the staking rewards program and communication to the community.
**Conclusion:
**
By approving this proposal, the Pooh DAO will actively support the Pooh token's market value and increase staking rewards for the community, which will further incentivize participation and long-term commitment to the ecosystem. The buyback and staking rewards enhancement initiative will strengthen the Pooh DAO's position as a value-driven and community-focused project.
